title: Uy, xonalar va jihozlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida xonalar va mebel nomlarini aytasiz, there is / there are bilan uyingizda nima borligini bildirasiz, predloglar bilan narsalar qayerda turganini aytasiz va sifatlar bilan uyingizni xonama-xona sakkizta gap bilan tasvirlaysiz.

scenes.title: Uyingiz haqida gapiring
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘ninchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ovqat, ichimlik va kafeda buyurtma berishni o‘rgandik. Bugun uyingiz haqida gapiramiz: xonalar, mebellar, ular qayerda turgani va qanday ekani. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida uyingizni xonama-xona, kamida sakkizta gap bilan tasvirlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about your home: rooms, furniture and where things are.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun uyingiz haqida gaplashamiz: xonalar, mebel va narsalar qayerda ekani.

scenes.title: Xonalar

examples.t: This is the kitchen.
I sleep in the bedroom.

scenes.say_native: Avval xonalar. Living room — mehmonxona yoki zal, bedroom — yotoqxona, kitchen — oshxona, bathroom — vannaxona, hall — yo‘lak yoki dahliz, balcony — balkon, garden — bog‘ yoki hovli. Britaniyada hojatxona ko‘pincha alohida xona bo‘ladi va “toilet” deyiladi. Qo‘shma so‘zlarda urg‘u birinchi qismda: BEDroom, BATHroom, LIVing room. Shuni diqqat bilan eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, hall, balcony, garden.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona, yotoqxona, oshxona, vannaxona, yo‘lak, balkon, bog‘.

scenes.title: Mebel va jihozlar

examples.t: There is a sofa in the living room.
The fridge is in the kitchen.

scenes.say_native: Endi mebel va jihozlar. Sofa — divan, armchair — kreslo, table — stol, chair — stul, bed — karavot, wardrobe — kiyim shkafi, desk — yozuv stoli, shelf — javon yoki tokcha, fridge — muzlatgich, cooker — gaz yoki elektr plita, lamp — chiroq. Muhim: “furniture” — mebel, sanalmaydigan ot. “A furniture” yoki “furnitures” deb bo‘lmaydi. Bitta narsa uchun “a chair” yoki “a table” deng.
scenes.say: Sofa, armchair, table, chair, bed, wardrobe, desk, shelf, fridge, cooker, lamp.
scenes.say_uz: Divan, kreslo, stol, stul, karavot, shkaf, yozuv stoli, javon, muzlatgich, plita, chiroq.

scenes.title: Qaysi xonada?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Savollarga xonaning nomi bilan javob bering. Birinchi: qayerda ovqat pishirasiz? Ikkinchi: qayerda uxlaysiz? Uchinchi: qayerda yuvinasiz? To‘rtinchi: qayerda televizor ko‘rasiz? Masalan: “I cook in the kitchen.” Baland ovozda ayting. Hozircha faqat xonaning nomini “in” bilan ishlating, murakkab gap kerak emas. Javob uchun qayerda ekanini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Where do you cook? Where do you sleep? Where do you wash? Where do you watch TV?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda ovqat pishirasiz? Qayerda uxlaysiz? Qayerda yuvinasiz? Qayerda televizor ko‘rasiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) I watch TV in the living room.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: I cook in the kitchen. I sleep in the bedroom. I wash in the bathroom. I watch TV in the living room. Hammasida xonadan oldin “in” keladi, o‘zbekchadagi “-da” qo‘shimchasi o‘rnida: oshxonada, yotoqxonada. Lekin “at home”, ya’ni uyda, deyilganda “in home” demaymiz, “at home” deymiz. Bu iborani alohida eslab qoling.
scenes.say: I cook in the kitchen. I sleep in the bedroom. I wash in the bathroom. I watch TV in the living room.
scenes.say_uz: Men oshxonada pishiraman. Yotoqxonada uxlayman. Vannaxonada yuvinaman. Mehmonxonada televizor ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Flat va house
board: a house · a block of flats

examples.t: I live in a flat.
Her flat is on the third floor.

scenes.say_native: Uy turlari. Kvartira Britaniyada “flat”, Amerikada “apartment” deyiladi. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. “House” — alohida hovli uy, “block of flats” — ko‘p qavatli bino. “Men kvartirada yashayman” deyish uchun “I live in a flat” deymiz. Qavatni “on the second floor” deb aytamiz, bu yerda “in” emas, “on”. “Yashayman” uchun oldingi darsdagi Present Simple ishlatiladi: I live.
scenes.say: I live in a flat. She lives in a house. My flat is on the second floor.
scenes.say_uz: Men kvartirada yashayman. U hovli uyda yashaydi. Mening kvartiram ikkinchi qavatda.

scenes.title: There is va there are
board: There's a sofa. · There are two chairs.

examples.t: There is a lamp on the desk.
There are three rooms in my flat.

scenes.say_native: Narsa bor ekanini aytish uchun “there is” va “there are” ishlatamiz. Bitta narsa bo‘lsa “there is”, qisqasi “there’s”: There’s a sofa. Ikki va undan ko‘p bo‘lsa “there are”: There are two chairs. Tanlov keyin keladigan otga bog‘liq. Gapni odatda “there is” bilan boshlaymiz, so‘ng narsa, so‘ng joy nomi. Shu tartib o‘zbek tilidagi “xonada divan bor” gapidan farq qiladi.
scenes.say: There is a sofa in the living room. There are two chairs in the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxonada divan bor. Oshxonada ikkita stul bor.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan taqqoslash
board: Xonada divan bor. → There is a sofa in the room.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada avval joy, keyin narsa va “bor” aytiladi: “Xonada divan bor”. Ingliz tilida esa “bor” ma’nosini gap boshidagi “there is” beradi, keyin narsa, so‘ng joy: “There is a sofa in the room.” Yana bir farq: o‘zbekchada “bor” ko‘plikda ham o‘zgarmaydi, inglizchada “is” bilan “are” ni ajratamiz. “Ikkita stul bor” — “There are two chairs.”
scenes.say: There is a sofa in the room. There are two chairs.
scenes.say_uz: Xonada divan bor. Ikkita stul bor.

scenes.title: Has va have emas, there is
board: ✗ In my room has a sofa.
✗ Is a sofa in my room.
✓ There is a sofa in my room.
✗ There is two chairs. ✓ There are two chairs.
scenes.say_native: Bu darsning asosiy xatosi: “In my room has a sofa” yoki “Is a sofa in my room”. Inglizcha gap “there” siz “bor” demaydi. To‘g‘risi: “There is a sofa in my room.” Ikkinchi xato: “There is two chairs”. Ikkita stul bor, shuning uchun “are”. Gapni boshlashdan oldin ot bitta yoki ko‘p ekanini o‘ylab oling. “Has” esa egalik uchun: “My flat has two bedrooms”.
scenes.say: There is a sofa in my room. There are two chairs in my room.
scenes.say_uz: Mening xonamda divan bor. Xonamda ikkita stul bor.

scenes.title: Is yoki are?
board: 1) There ___ a table in the kitchen.
2) There ___ three beds in the room.
3) There ___ a lamp on the desk.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joyda “is” yoki “are” ayting. Birinchi: there is yoki are a table in the kitchen. Ikkinchi: there is yoki are three beds in the room. Uchinchi: there is yoki are a lamp on the desk. To‘rtinchi: there is yoki are two windows. To‘liq gapni ayting.
scenes.say: There, a table in the kitchen. There, three beds in the room. There, a lamp on the desk. There, two windows.
scenes.say_uz: Oshxonada stol bor. Xonada uchta karavot bor. Chiroq va ikkita kitob bor. Ikkita deraza bor.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) There is a table in the kitchen.
2) There are three beds in the room.
3) There is a lamp on the desk.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: There is a table in the kitchen. There are three beds in the room. There are two windows. Uchinchi gapda “a lamp” bitta, shuning uchun “is”. Ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi gaplarda esa “three beds” va “two windows” ko‘plik, shuning uchun “are”. Qoida shu: otga qarab tanlang.
scenes.say: There is a table in the kitchen. There are three beds in the room. There is a lamp on the desk. There are two windows.
scenes.say_uz: Oshxonada stol bor. Xonada uchta karavot bor. Chiroq va ikkita kitob bor. Ikkita deraza bor.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol
board: There isn't a TV. · There aren't any chairs.
Is there a balcony? · Are there any shops?
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.

examples.t: Is there a garden?
There aren't any chairs.

scenes.say_native: Inkor: “there isn’t” — bitta narsa yo‘q, “there aren’t” — ko‘p narsa yo‘q. Savolda “is” va “are” gap boshiga chiqadi: Is there a balcony? Are there any chairs? Javob: “Yes, there is” yoki “No, there isn’t”. Ko‘plikda “Yes, there are” yoki “No, there aren’t”. Savol va inkorda sanaladigan ko‘plik ot oldidan “any” ishlatiladi. Darak gapda esa “some” keladi.
scenes.say: Is there a balcony? Yes, there is. Are there any chairs? No, there aren't.
scenes.say_uz: Balkon bormi? Ha, bor. Stullar bormi? Yo‘q, yo‘q.

scenes.title: A, an, some, any

examples.t: There is an armchair.
Are there any shelves?

scenes.say_native: Artikllar haqida. Bitta narsa oldidan “a”, lekin unli tovush bilan boshlansa “an”: an armchair, an apple. Ko‘plikda yoki sanalmaydigan otda aniq son bo‘lmasa, darak gapda “some” ishlatamiz: There are some chairs. Savol va inkorda esa “any”: Are there any chairs? There aren’t any chairs. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun “a” ni unutish tabiiy, lekin bu ingliz tilida muhim.
scenes.say: There is an armchair. There are some chairs. Are there any shelves? There aren't any.
scenes.say_uz: Kreslo bor. Bir nechta stul bor. Javonlar bormi? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savol va inkor
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Gaplarni o‘zgartiring. Birinchi: “There is a TV” gapidan savol tuzing. Ikkinchi: “There are some chairs” gapidan savol tuzing, “some” o‘rniga “any”. Uchinchi: “There is a balcony” gapini inkorga aylantiring. Baland ovozda ayting. Gap boshida “is” yoki “are” bo‘lishi, savolda esa uning gap boshiga chiqishi kerakligini unutmang, inkorda “not” qo‘shiladi.
scenes.say: There is a TV. There are some chairs. There is a balcony.
scenes.say_uz: Televizor bor. Bir nechta stul bor. Balkon bor.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Is there a TV? Are there any chairs? There isn’t a balcony. Savolda “is” gap boshiga o‘tdi, “there” undan keyin turadi. “Any” savolda “some” ning o‘rnini oldi. Inkorni “There is not a balcony” deb ham aytish mumkin, lekin og‘zaki nutqda qisqa shakl “isn’t” ishlatiladi. Savolga qisqa javob ham tayyor: “Yes, there is” yoki “No, there isn’t”.
scenes.say: Is there a TV? Are there any chairs? There isn't a balcony.
scenes.say_uz: Televizor bormi? Stullar bormi? Balkon yo‘q.

scenes.title: Uy qismlari
board: The window is next to the door.

examples.t: The stairs are near the hall.
There is a big yard.

scenes.say_native: Xonalardan tashqari uyning qismlarini ham bilish kerak. Door — eshik, window — deraza, wall — devor, floor — pol, ceiling — shift, stairs — zina, yard — hovli. “Floor” so‘zi ikki ma’noda ishlatiladi: pol va qavat. “The floor is clean” — pol toza, “on the second floor” — ikkinchi qavatda. Eshik va deraza bir donadan ham, ko‘p ham bo‘lishi mumkin, shuning uchun “is” va “are” ni ajrating. Zina esa doim ko‘plikda: the stairs are.
scenes.say: Door, window, wall, floor, ceiling, stairs, yard. The stairs are near the hall.
scenes.say_uz: Eshik, deraza, devor, pol, shift, zina, hovli. Zina yo‘lak yaqinida.

scenes.title: Where is va where are
board: Where is the lamp? → It's on the desk.
Where are the keys? → They're in the bag.
Here it is! · Here they are!

examples.t: Where is the fridge?
Where are my shoes?

scenes.say_native: Narsa qayerda ekanini so‘rash uchun “Where is…?” yoki “Where are…?” deymiz. Bitta narsa bo‘lsa “Where is the lamp?”, ko‘p bo‘lsa “Where are the keys?”. Javobda “it” va “they”: “It’s on the desk”, “They’re in the bag”. Ingliz tilida so‘z tartibi aniq: savol so‘zi, “is” yoki “are”, keyin narsa. O‘zbekchada “chiroq qayerda?” desak ham bo‘ladi, bu yerda “is” ni tushirmang.
scenes.say: Where is the lamp? It's on the desk. Where are the keys? They're in the bag.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroq qayerda? U stol ustida. Kalitlar qayerda? Ular sumkada.

scenes.title: Joy predloglari: in, on, under

examples.t: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.

scenes.say_native: Joy predloglari. “In” — biror narsaning ichida: in the box, in the room. “On” — sirtida, tegib turgan holda: on the table, on the wall. “Under” — tagida: under the chair. O‘zbek tilidagi “-da”, “ustida”, “tagida” so‘zlari ularga mos keladi. Predloglar otdan oldin keladi, o‘zbekchada esa so‘z oxirida turadigan qo‘shimcha. Shuning uchun “table on” emas, “on the table”.
scenes.say: The keys are in the bag. The book is on the table. The cat is under the chair.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlar sumkada. Kitob stol ustida. Mushuk stul tagida.

scenes.title: Next to, behind, between

examples.t: The lamp is next to the sofa.
The chair is between the bed and the desk.

scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta predlog. Next to — yonida. Behind — orqasida. In front of — oldida. Between — ikkitasining o‘rtasida. Masalan: The lamp is next to the sofa. The shoes are behind the door. The TV is in front of the sofa. The chair is between the bed and the desk. “Between” da doim ikkita narsa bo‘ladi va ularni “and” bog‘laydi. Shuningdek, “near” — yaqinida.
scenes.say: Next to the sofa. Behind the door. In front of the TV. Between the bed and the desk.
scenes.say_uz: Divanning yonida. Eshik orqasida. Televizor oldida. Karavot va stol o‘rtasida.

scenes.title: In va on aralashmasin
board: ✗ The book is in the table.
✓ The book is on the table.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p o‘quvchilar “in” va “on” ni aralashtiradi. Kitob stol ichida emas, ustida, shuning uchun “on the table”. Yana bir xato: “in home”. Uy haqida “at home” deymiz, “I am at home”. Lekin uyning ichidagi xonalar uchun “in”: “in the kitchen”. Ba’zi hollarda o‘zbek tilidagi “-da” qo‘shimchasi hammasini bir xil qiladi, inglizchada esa uch xil predlog bor, shuning uchun har bir holat uchun mosini tanlang.
scenes.say: The book is on the table. I am at home. I am in the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob stol ustida. Men uydaman. Men oshxonadaman.

scenes.title: Rasm bo‘yicha joylashuv
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Tasavvur qiling, xonada narsalar bor. Stol ustida chiroq va kitob. Stol tagida mushuk. Divan yonida o‘simlik. Eshik orqasida poyabzal. Har bir narsa qayerda ekanini “is” yoki “are” bilan ayting. Masalan: “The lamp is on the table.” Boshlang. Har bir javobda to‘g‘ri predlogni tanlang: ustida bo‘lsa “on”, tagida bo‘lsa “under”, yonida bo‘lsa “next to”, orqasida bo‘lsa “behind”.
scenes.say: Where is the lamp? Where is the cat? Where is the plant? Where are the shoes?
scenes.say_uz: Chiroq qayerda? Mushuk qayerda? O‘simlik qayerda? Poyabzal qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The lamp and the book are on the table.
The cat is under the table.
The plant is next to the sofa.
The shoes are behind the door.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: The lamp is on the table. The book is on the table. The cat is under the table. The plant is next to the sofa. The shoes are behind the door. Diqqat: “shoes” ko‘plik, shuning uchun “are”. Savol “Where is…?” bo‘lsa javob “It’s…”, ko‘plikda “Where are…?” bo‘lsa javob “They’re…”. Bu juda foydali tuzilma, keyingi darsda yo‘l so‘rash uchun ham kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The lamp is on the table. The cat is under the table. The plant is next to the sofa. The shoes are behind the door.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroq stol ustida. Mushuk stol tagida. O‘simlik divan yonida. Poyabzal eshik orqasida.

scenes.title: There is dan keyin it va they
board: There is a sofa. It is big.
There are two beds. They are new.

examples.t: There is a table. It is old.
There are two lamps. They are small.

scenes.say_native: Yangi narsani birinchi marta aytganimizda “there is” ishlatamiz. Keyin esa shu narsa haqida gapirsak, “there” emas, “it” yoki “they” deymiz. There is a sofa. It is big. There are two beds. They are new. “There” faqat narsaning mavjudligini bildiradi. U haqida ma’lumot berganda gapning egasi “it” yoki “they” bo‘ladi. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi “U katta” degan gapga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say: There is a sofa. It is big. There are two beds. They are new.
scenes.say_uz: Divan bor. U katta. Ikkita karavot bor. Ular yangi.

scenes.title: Hajm va holat: sifatlar

examples.t: My room is small but tidy.
The kitchen is light and modern.

scenes.say_native: Endi tasvirlash uchun sifatlar. Hajm: big — katta, small — kichik, large — keng, tiny — juda kichik. Holat: new — yangi, old — eski, clean — toza, dirty — iflos, tidy — ozoda, messy — tartibsiz. Yana quiet — tinch, noisy — shovqinli, light — yorug‘, dark — qorong‘i, comfortable — qulay, modern — zamonaviy. Bu so‘zlar juft-juft yodlanadi, chunki ular bir-biriga qarama-qarshi.
scenes.say: Big, small, new, old, clean, dirty, tidy, messy, light, dark, comfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Katta, kichik, yangi, eski, toza, iflos, ozoda, tartibsiz, yorug‘, qorong‘i, qulay.

scenes.title: Sifat otdan oldin, o‘zgarmaydi
board: a big room · a new sofa
The room is big. (is dan keyin)

examples.t: It is a comfortable bed.
The chairs are old.

scenes.say_native: Sifatning o‘rni. Ingliz tilida sifat otdan oldin turadi: a big room, a new sofa. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: katta xona, yangi divan. Bundan tashqari, sifat ko‘plikda ham o‘zgarmaydi: two small chairs, “smalls” emas, “small”. “Be” fe’lidan keyin ham sifat o‘zgarmay keladi: The chairs are old. Sifat bilan ot o‘rtasiga boshqa so‘z kirmaydi, bitta “a” bo‘lsa, u sifatdan oldin turadi.
scenes.say: It is a big room. There are two small chairs. The chairs are old.
scenes.say_uz: Bu katta xona. Ikkita kichik stul bor. Stullar eski.

scenes.title: Sifatning noto‘g‘ri o‘rni
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “I have a room big”. O‘zbekchada sifat otdan oldin keladi: katta xona. Inglizchada ham shunday: “a big room”. Ikkinchisi: sifatni ko‘plikka qo‘yish, “smalls chairs”. Sifat hech qachon “s” olmaydi: “two small chairs”. Yana bir xato: “a” ni tushirib qoldirish, “I have big room”. To‘g‘risi: “I have a big room”.
scenes.say: I have a big room. There are two small chairs.
scenes.say_uz: Mening katta xonam bor. Ikkita kichik stul bor.

scenes.title: Xonani tasvirlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta xonani gap bilan tasvirlang. Yotoqxona kichik va ozoda, unda karavot va shkaf bor. Oshxona katta va yorug‘, unda muzlatgich va stol bor. Mehmonxona qulay, unda divan va televizor bor. “There is” yoki “there are”, joy va sifat ishlating. Masalan: “The bedroom is small and tidy.”
scenes.say: Describe the bedroom, the kitchen and the living room.
scenes.say_uz: Yotoqxonani, oshxonani va mehmonxonani tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The bedroom is small and tidy. There is a bed and a wardrobe.
The kitchen is big and light. There is a fridge and a table.
The living room is comfortable. There is a sofa and a TV.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar: The bedroom is small and tidy. There is a bed and a wardrobe. The kitchen is big and light. There is a fridge and a table. The living room is comfortable. There is a sofa and a TV. E’tibor bering, avval umumiy tavsif “is” bilan beriladi, keyin “there is” bilan ichida nima borligi aytiladi. Shu tartibni yodda tuting.
scenes.say: The bedroom is small and tidy. There is a bed and a wardrobe. The kitchen is big and light.
scenes.say_uz: Yotoqxona kichik va ozoda. Karavot va shkaf bor. Oshxona katta va yorug‘.

scenes.title: Be va have: xona va uy

examples.t: The flat has a balcony.
My room has a big window.

scenes.say_native: Uchta usul bir narsani aytadi. “The flat is big” — kvartira qanday. “The flat has two bedrooms” — kvartiraning tarkibi, ya’ni unda nima borligi. “There are two bedrooms in the flat” — xonalar mavjudligi. “Has” butun narsa, ya’ni kvartira yoki xona, o‘z tarkibini aytganda ishlatiladi. “There are” esa mavjudlikni bildiradi. Ikkala gap ham to‘g‘ri, o‘zingizga qulay variantni tanlang.
scenes.say: The flat has two bedrooms. There are two bedrooms in the flat.
scenes.say_uz: Kvartirada ikkita yotoqxona bor. Kvartirada ikkita yotoqxona bor.

scenes.title: Uy haqida so‘rash
board: Which floor do you live on?

examples.t: How many bedrooms are there?
What's your room like?

scenes.say_native: Uy haqida savollar. “What’s your flat like?” — kvartirangiz qanday? Javob sifat bilan: “It’s small but nice.” “How many rooms are there?” — nechta xona bor? Javob: “There are three.” “Is there a balcony?” — balkon bormi? Va “Which floor do you live on?” — qaysi qavatda yashaysiz? E’tibor bering, “how many” dan keyin ko‘plikdagi ot va “are there” keladi.
scenes.say: What's your flat like? How many rooms are there? Is there a balcony?
scenes.say_uz: Kvartirangiz qanday? Nechta xona bor? Balkon bormi?

scenes.title: How many savolidagi xato
scenes.say_native: Savolda so‘z tartibi muhim. “How many room there is?” noto‘g‘ri uch jihatdan: ot ko‘plikda bo‘lishi kerak, “are” kerak va tartib teskari. To‘g‘risi: “How many rooms are there?” Savol so‘zlaridan keyin yordamchi so‘z darhol keladi, keyin “there”. O‘zbekchada “necha xona bor?” desak yetarli, shuning uchun bu tartibni mashq qilib o‘rganing.
scenes.say: How many rooms are there? There are three rooms.
scenes.say_uz: Nechta xona bor? Uchta xona bor.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: yangi kvartira
board: Big? How many rooms? Balcony? Garden?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Sara do‘sti Tomdan uning yangi kvartirasi haqida so‘raydi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, to‘rtta savolga javob bering: kvartira katta ekanmi? Nechta xona bor? Balkon bormi, u qanday? Bog‘ bormi? Diqqat bilan tinglang. Dialog tezligi sekin, lekin so‘zlarni to‘liq tushunishga harakat qiling. Kerak bo‘lsa, dars oxirida yana tinglang.
scenes.say: Tom, is your new flat big? Not very big, but it's nice. How many rooms are there? There are three: a living room, a bedroom and a kitchen. Is there a balcony? Yes, there is a small balcony. It's quiet and light. And is there a garden? No, there isn't, but there's a park near the flat.
scenes.say_uz: Tom, yangi kvartirangiz kattami? Juda katta emas, lekin yaxshi. Nechta xona bor? Uchta: mehmonxona, yotoqxona va oshxona. Balkon bormi? Ha, kichik balkon bor. U tinch va yorug‘. Bog‘ bormi? Yo‘q, lekin kvartira yaqinida bog‘ bor.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: kvartira katta ekanmi? Ikkinchi: nechta xona bor va qaysilari? Uchinchi: balkon qanday? To‘rtinchi: bog‘ bormi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, “there is” yoki “there are” ishlatib ayting. Qisqa javob ham qabul qilinadi, masalan, “Yes, there is”.
scenes.say: Is the flat big? How many rooms are there? What is the balcony like? Is there a garden?
scenes.say_uz: Kvartira kattami? Nechta xona bor? Balkon qanday? Bog‘ bormi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Three: a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen.
4) No, there isn't. There's a park near.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Kvartira juda katta emas. Uchta xona bor: mehmonxona, yotoqxona va oshxona. Balkon kichik, tinch va yorug‘. Bog‘ yo‘q, lekin yaqinida park bor. Ko‘rdingizmi, qisqa javob ham to‘liq javob ham mumkin. Dialogda “but” ham ishlatildi: “No, there isn’t, but there’s a park”. “But” — lekin, qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.
scenes.say: It isn't very big. There are three rooms. The balcony is small, quiet and light. There isn't a garden, but there's a park.
scenes.say_uz: U juda katta emas. Uchta xona bor. Balkon kichik, tinch va yorug‘. Bog‘ yo‘q, lekin park bor.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: there’s va there are
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. “There” so‘zidagi “th” jarangli tovush /ð/, til uchi tishlar orasida turadi va ovoz chiqadi. “There’s” bitta bo‘g‘in bo‘lib, oxirida “z” eshitiladi. “There are” da “are” tez nutqda juda zaif aytiladi. O‘zbek tilida bu tovush yo‘q, shuning uchun tilingiz uchini tishlaringiz orasiga qo‘yib mashq qiling.
scenes.say: There's a sofa. There are two chairs. This is the bathroom.
scenes.say_uz: Divan bor. Ikkita stul bor. Bu vannaxona.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: The cat is under the table.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Uchta gapni avval sekin, keyin tabiiy tezlikda ayting. “There” dagi “th” da tilingiz tishlaringiz orasida bo‘lsin. Yordamchi so‘zlar, ya’ni “there’s” va “are”, zaif va tez, “sofa”, “chairs” va “table” esa kuchliroq. So‘zlar orasida to‘xtamang.
scenes.say: There's a sofa. There are two chairs. The cat is under the table.
scenes.say_uz: Divan bor. Ikkita stul bor. Mushuk stol tagida.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: kalitlar qayerda?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Qiz otasidan kalitlari qayerda ekanini so‘raydi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob bering: ota avval kalitlar qayerda deydi? Ular o‘sha yerdami? Kalitlar oxirida qayerdan topiladi? Predloglarga e’tibor bering. Savollarni oldindan o‘qib oling, shunda javobni topish osonroq bo‘ladi va dialogda nimaga quloq solishni bilasiz.
scenes.say: Dad, where are my keys? They're on the kitchen table, next to the bag. No, they aren't there. Look in the hall. Are they on the chair? No, they aren't. Oh, here they are! They're under the chair, behind the shoes. Thanks, Dad!
scenes.say_uz: Dada, kalitlarim qayerda? Ular oshxona stolida, sumka yonida. Yo‘q, u yerda emas. Yo‘lakka qarang. Stulning ustidami? Yo‘q. Voy, mana ular! Stul tagida, poyabzal orqasida. Rahmat, dada!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) Where does Dad say the keys are first?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: ota avval kalitlar qayerda deydi? Ikkinchi: kalitlar o‘sha yerdami? Uchinchi: kalitlar oxirida qayerdan topiladi? Javobni “They are…” bilan boshlang va to‘g‘ri predlogni tanlang. Masalan: “They are on the…”. Baland ovozda ayting. Har bir javobda predlog va joy nomini aniq ayting, chunki bu dialogning asosiy mazmuni.
scenes.say: Where does Dad say the keys are first? Are they there? Where are the keys finally?
scenes.say_uz: Ota avval kalitlar qayerda deydi? Ular u yerdami? Kalitlar oxirida qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) On the kitchen table, next to the bag.
3) In the hall, under the chair, behind the shoes.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ota avval kalitlar oshxona stolida, sumka yonida, deydi. Lekin ular u yerda emas. Kalitlar yo‘lakda, stul tagida, poyabzal orqasida topiladi. Dialogda “Here they are!” iborasi ham bor, ya’ni “mana ular!”. Biror narsani topganda shunday deyiladi. Bitta narsa bo‘lsa “Here it is!”.
scenes.say: On the kitchen table, next to the bag. No, they aren't. In the hall, under the chair, behind the shoes.
scenes.say_uz: Oshxona stolida, sumka yonida. Yo‘q. Yo‘lakda, stul tagida, poyabzal orqasida.

scenes.title: Uyingizni tasvirlang
board: Home: a flat / a house. It is ...
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Ekrandagi reja bo‘yicha uyingiz haqida kamida sakkizta gap ayting. Avval uy turini va nechta xona borligini ayting. Keyin ikkita xonani tasvirlang: nimalar bor, ular qayerda turibdi, qanday. Oxirida sevimli xonangiz haqida ayting. Pauza paytida baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Now describe your home. Say eight sentences. Use there is, there are, in, on, next to and adjectives. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi uyingizni tasvirlang. Sakkizta gap ayting. There is, there are, in, on, next to va sifatlarni ishlating. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna tasvir
board: I live in a flat. There are three rooms.
The living room is big and light. There is a sofa and a TV.
There are two chairs next to the window.
My favourite room is the kitchen.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: I live in a flat. There are three rooms. The living room is big and light. There is a sofa and a TV in it. There are two chairs next to the window. The bedroom is small but tidy. My favourite room is the kitchen. Sizning tasviringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiysi: “there is” va “there are” to‘g‘ri tanlangan, joy predloglari o‘rnida, sifatlar otdan oldin turibdi.
scenes.say: I live in a flat. There are three rooms. The living room is big and light. There is a sofa and a TV. My favourite room is the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Men kvartirada yashayman. Uchta xona bor. Mehmonxona katta va yorug‘. Divan va televizor bor. Sevimli xonam oshxona.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: There is / There are · isn't / aren't · Is there...?
in · on · under · next to · behind · between
big · small · new · old · tidy · light
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Xonalar va mebel nomlarini o‘rgandik. Narsa borligini bitta narsa uchun “there is”, ko‘p narsa uchun “there are” bilan aytishni, inkor va savol shakllarini bildik. “In”, “on”, “under”, “next to”, “behind”, “between” bilan narsa qayerda turganini aytdik. Sifatlar bilan hajm va holatni tasvirladik. Sifat otdan oldin keladi va “s” olmaydi.
scenes.say: Great work! Now you can describe your home, the rooms and the furniture.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r ish! Endi uyingizni, xonalarni va mebelni tasvirlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Describe your home room by room in 8 sentences
Use there is / there are, prepositions, adjectives
Check: is / are, a / an, adjective before noun
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Uyingizni xonama-xona, sakkizta gap bilan tasvirlang. Har bir xonada nima borligini “there is” yoki “there are” bilan, narsalar qayerda turganini predloglar bilan, qanday ekanini sifatlar bilan yozing. Tekshiring: “is” va “are” to‘g‘ri tanlanganmi, “a” yoki “an” bormi, sifat otdan oldinmi? Keyingi darsda shaharda yo‘l so‘rash va tushuntirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Describe your home in eight sentences. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyingizni sakkizta gap bilan tasvirlang. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Uyingizni xonama-xona 8 ta gap bilan tasvirlang. Mezon: there is / there are to‘g‘ri tanlangan; kamida 3 ta joy predlogi (in, on, under, next to, behind, between); kamida 3 ta sifat otdan oldin yoki be dan keyin; a/an qo‘yilgan; In my room has... kabi xato yo‘q.

options: In my room has a sofa.
There is a sofa in my room.
Is a sofa in my room.
My room there is a sofa.

quiz.q: There ___ two chairs in the kitchen.

quiz.why_uz: Savolda is gap boshiga chiqadi: Is there a balcony?
Sirtida tegib turgan narsa: on the table.
Sifat otdan oldin turadi: a big room.
Sifat ko‘plikda o‘zgarmaydi; two small chairs, there are.

quiz.q: The lamp is ___ the sofa and the desk.

quiz.why_uz: How many + ko‘plik ot + are there?
Qisqa javob savolning yordamchi so‘zi bilan: No, there isn't.

quiz.q: Which word is NOT used for “mebel”?
